parameters.content:
## Supabase Single-Project Monitoring & Data Quality

**Setup**
1. Run `sql/01_central_store.sql` + `sql/02_collector_rpc.sql` + `sql/03_seed_rules_and_projects.sql` on your ONE Supabase project — it holds both the monitoring tables and the data being monitored.
2. Open the **Monitor Config** node and fill in `MON_CENTRAL_URL`, `MON_CENTRAL_KEY`, and `MON_REPORT_TO` (no environment variables needed — works on free/cloud n8n).
3. Pick your SMTP credential on **Email Report** and set `fromEmail`.

All discovery + profiling happens inside `mon_collect()` (one round trip), which is why so few nodes cover any number of tables.
